desc: The lever-action 22LR is an American classic. Chiappa continues this legacy by using modern technology and materials to produce the LA322. This beautiful rimfire is as attractive as it is functional. Accurate, quick handling and rapid shooting, the LA322 embodies all the qualities that Americans want in a lever-action rifle. A 3/8in dovetail is machined into the top of the receiver for optics. Another coveted feature is the take down design for easy transport and storage.
